title: Five Seconds (IS2026)
synopsis:
In an isolated Tuscan valley, Adriano, a 50-year-old man haunted by a troubled past, lives alone in the renovated stables of a crumbling villa. His isolation is abruptly challenged when a group of young idealists takes over the neighboring villa, hoping to restore its abandoned vineyards. As Adriano tries to drive away these uninvited guests, their stubborn hope begins to crack his defenses, and a quiet understanding between two generations takes root amidst the soil and vines.

 

Nastri d'Argento Awards: Best Actor

Rome Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
50 歲的 Adriano 獨自一人住在日久失修的房子，過著贖罪般的日子，孤僻得連家裏漏水斷電都拒絕幫助。偏偏一群年輕人看中隔壁的空置別墅，懷著滿腔理想復耕荒廢已久的葡萄園。在千方百計想趕走這群不速之客的過程中，Adriano 因為傷痛而封閉已久的心在不知不覺間被打開。兩代人的互相救贖，讓彼此的未來在泥土與藤蔓間，緩慢地向上生長。

 

意大利銀絲帶獎 最佳男主角

羅馬電影節
